introHtml: Full color printing on buttons, stickers, and patches brings your designs to life with vibrant, photo-quality detail. Unlike single-color or foil stamping, full color allows gradients, logos, and photographs to reproduce accurately. Marketing directors and business owners choose this option for event giveaways, product labels, and branded apparel patches where visual impact matters. Decorate with up to 6 colors plus photographic effects on durable materials that withstand everyday use.
